highest_value_findings: Cancellation requires a reference to the actual running executor and bounded interrupt points; state-only cancellation had been ineffective.

Qwen first hallucinated nonexistent file paths, then was forced into a fixed five-tool depth rule after shallow analysis; current Harness should require authoritative resource inventory plus evidence/coverage saturation rather than count Goodharting.

Assistant-generated text could propose an action that a button or short confirmation escalated into agentic execution. Proposal text must never become authority without an explicit typed user-intent/approval transition.

Live runtime databases were intentionally tracked in source control in this lineage. Current release tooling must reject runtime memory/state databases and sensitive state from code-package provenance.
Broad substring/keyword routers repeatedly triggered tools from reflective or creative prose; ambiguity and long-form conversational inputs require safe non-effect fallback.

Scheduled affect/personality-modulation agent lineage is preserved as historical architecture but must not grant generated interpretations authority over persistent self-state without explicit governance and consent boundaries.

branch_feedback.needle_router: Separate generated proposal, user confirmation, validated intent, reservation, authority and effect commit. Use safe fallback on ambiguous long-form text; modality and UI affordance must not create bypasses.
branch_feedback.harness: Add cancellation-liveness, hallucinated-resource, shallow-evidence, fixed-count-Goodhart, action-escalation-authority, long-text false-positive and runtime-DB-source-leak fixtures.
branch_feedback.claycode: Represent executor handle/resource identity, cancellation, proposal-vs-authority, evidence coverage and source/runtime artifact class explicitly in typed IR/runtime contracts.
branch_feedback.unifieddb_rae: Mark source artifacts vs runtime state/memory as distinct provenance classes and reject accidental persistent-state export into source snapshots.
branch_feedback.gwt: Generated self-report/proposal remains generated content until grounded by evidence or authorized action receipts; do not broadcast it as truth/authority.
branch_feedback.privacy_release: Release audit must scan for runtime DBs, credentials, personal/session state and generated caches before any repository/package export.

earned_work.reason: Strong regression-test value but overlaps routing/authority/recovery/privacy mappings; final row-level dedup required.

level0_effect.reason: Commit-event semantic closure is a sub-denominator signal only; combined Level-0 denominator remains unfrozen.
